records.researcher_notes: PJM's first-cycle queue lists request C01-1569: 346 MW of natural gas generation in Will County, Illinois, from Will County Facility LLC. It was filed on April 25, 2026, connects at the Braidwood 345 kV switchyard, and asks to be in service by December 31, 2029. I read these values from PJM's own full queue export, downloaded on October 29, 2026. The interconnection.fyi page for the request at https://www.interconnection.fyi/project/pjm-c01-1569 shows the same size, fuel, county, developer and completion date. PJM's page for the request at https://www.pjm.com/m/ProjectTransition/SISReportDetails?queueNumber=C01-1569 confirms the queue number, the developer and the filing date. A grid queue entry makes the status announced. The plant is named after the developer's company name, since no other name is published. The owner is Will County Facility LLC at 100 percent. PJM's page for the request names it as the company behind the request, and the interconnection.fyi page says the project is owned by it. Both pages were checked again on October 30, 2026. GEM accepts a project company as the owner. The parent company is Constellation Energy. Two reports Constellation Energy Corporation filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, on April 15 and July 20, 2026, list Will County Facility LLC among the companies where its officers hold posts, and the July report says Constellation Energy Corporation owns enough of each listed company to elect its directors. Both reports were checked on October 30, 2026. Constellation Energy is already in GEM's company list as entity 100001000208, so it is not a new company. Will County Facility LLC is not in GEM's company list, so it is a new company record. The size and fuel come from a queue tracker site, not PJM's own page, so they are less certain until PJM posts a study report. Not found: a news story, permit, site address or turbine type. The location is approximate. No document gives the plant's own site, so the point is placed at the Braidwood 345 kV switchyard, where PJM says the request connects. The switchyard sits at the Braidwood nuclear station, which the EIA-860M table for September 2026 places at 41.24350, -88.22860. On satellite imagery the switchyard is the fenced yard just north and east of the reactor buildings, about 470 meters north of that point. The point is the middle of that yard, 41.24770, -88.22800: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=41.24770,-88.22800. The plant could be built anywhere on or near Constellation's land at the station. Move the point if a permit or study report names the site. Checked for duplicates on October 30, 2026. GEM has no plant of any fuel at the Braidwood nuclear station, where this request connects. The nearest GEM plant is CPV Three Rivers energy center, about 15 kilometers away, which is a different, operating plant. No GEM wiki page or other request in this batch names Will County Facility LLC. Three gas requests of about 346 MW each were filed on the same day at Constellation's Braidwood, Byron and LaSalle nuclear stations, and the same reports tie all three companies to Constellation. They are separate sites, so each is its own plant.
